mapper.select: SELECT ADDRESS_ID AS addressId, ADDRESS_ALIAS AS addressAlias, ZIPCODE AS zipcode, ADDRESS AS address, DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress, DEFAULT_YN AS defaultYn, USER_ID AS userId, RECEIVER_NAME AS receiverName, RECEIVER_PHONE AS receiverPhone FROM USER_ADDRESS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY DEFAULT_YN DESC, ADDRESS_ID DESC
